description: eBay Browse API client for official marketplace listing search, item details, prices and category hints. Requires an application OAuth token. The current account has no recorded API credentials or EPN campaign, and an anonymous production probe returned 403 HTML; product reads remain unverified.

capabilities.title: Acquire an eBay application access token for Browse API reads
capabilities.blocker: No eBay client ID/secret or live application token was available for this run. An anonymous request returned 403 text/html, which does not prove whether the cause is missing authorization or production access.

capabilities.title: Search fixed-price eBay listings by keyword and optional category
capabilities.blocker: The request contract and response validation are implemented, but search has not passed a credentialed live replay. The anonymous control received 403 text/html. Production Buy API access has a separate approval process.

capabilities.title: Read one purchasable listing by its Browse item ID
capabilities.note: The method accepts only the RESTful v1|item_id|variation_id form returned by Browse. It does not accept an unconverted legacy listing ID.

capabilities.title: Read current listing or auction price and currency without floating-point conversion
capabilities.note: Current fixed-price item price and currentBidPrice are separate decimal strings. Shipping costs are separate. No landed total is computed; VAT inclusion depends on marketplace and request context.

capabilities.title: Validate Browse search continuation and expose the next offset
capabilities.note: Page sizes are bounded to 1-200 and offsets to 0-9999; the response continuation URL is validated against the same query, category, fixed-price filter and page size before only its next offset is returned.

capabilities.title: Return category hints present in Browse search results
capabilities.blocker: Only categories returned by the Search response are handled. A full marketplace category tree and taxonomy traversal are not implemented.

capabilities.title: Read all variations and their per-variant prices for a multi-variation listing
capabilities.blocker: The official get_items_by_item_group endpoint is documented but has not been implemented or replayed.

capabilities.title: Return an eBay Partner Network tracking URL tied to the publisher's campaign
capabilities.note: The client accepts a caller-provided 10-digit affiliateCampaignId and optional reference ID. No campaign ID is embedded in code or returned as verified.

capabilities.title: Sign in to an eBay marketplace buyer account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This scoped capability uses an application OAuth token for public Browse reads; a buyer account login is not part of the requested catalog lookup.

capabilities.title: Place a purchase, checkout, bid, or order through eBay
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The current eBay adapter scope is product and price reads only; no purchase, checkout, bid, or order write was requested.
